run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained blocked by the organisation egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403) again this run — reconfirmed with a live WebFetch of https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm (EGRESS_BLOCKED) while the proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty). Per /root/.ccr/README.md a 403 from the proxy is a non-retryable organisation egress-policy denial, so no tender detail page or specification/RFT document could be opened directly. Every opportunity below is therefore captured from WebSearch only: existence / ID / open-status from the verifiable result-link <title> text (e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable), and any buyer / title / date / scope detail from WebSearch answer snippets (which summarise the target page and are treated as SNIPPET-DERIVED, not independently verified — flagged in each entry's notes and detail_source). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search (NSW buy.nsw/eTendering, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). AusTender surfaced buyer-originated Current-ATM notices not present in the routine's known dedup keys: ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM (Defence/ASCA 'Power Challenge' land-force energy, open, closes 15-Oct-2026), OPC-2026-02 and OPC-2026-03 (Office of Parliamentary Counsel — printing & distribution of Australian Government Bills), HOMEAFFAIRS/2165/RFT and ATM_2026_3858 (Department of Home Affairs — the latter an International Business Verification digital solution for Offshore Treatment Providers), and ATM_2026_6786. Several AusTender IDs seen in search were confirmed CLOSED/stale and excluded: OET-DRC-2026 (closed ~28-Aug-2026), PR10031930-RASS (Remote Air Services Subsidy, closed Apr/May 2026), ASCA EDT P2ISR RFP (closed 18-May-2026), ATM_2026_6066 (EOI Strategic Property Purchases, closed 3-Aug-2026). Tier 2 (Sydney Water, WaterNSW, VendorPanel councils) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio/Fortescue-class buyers) were probed via search but returned only known portals or login-gated boards this run — no publicly-visible, verifiable, still-open corporate opportunity surfaced. Genuinely new buyer-originated corporate sources identified: BlueScope Steel Pty Ltd E-Tendering (TenderLink) and Cleanaway Operations Pty Ltd E-Tendering (TenderLink) + Coupa Supplier Portal.
gaps: WebFetch egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED / HTTP 403) for every external host this run — confirmed against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm. No tender detail page or specification/RFT document could be opened, so all deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria fields are null unless summarised in a WebSearch snippet, and ALL snippet-derived detail (including dates, values and scope) is unverified against the source notice.

AusTender current-ATM list, per-jurisdiction search endpoints, and per-tender detail pages were reachable only via WebSearch result titles/snippets, not by direct fetch; pagination could not be walked, so Tier 1 coverage is a sample of what surfaced in search, not exhaustive.

OPC-2026-02, OPC-2026-03, HOMEAFFAIRS/2165/RFT, ATM_2026_3858 and ATM_2026_6786 are confirmed as Current ATMs from result titles, but publish dates, closing dates, values and full deliverables were not returned in snippets — left null (headline-level, pending detail). OPC-2026-02 scope (printing/distribution of Australian Government Bills, services 17-Sep-2026 to 16-Sep-2029) and ATM_2026_3858 scope (OTP International Business Verification digital solution) are snippet-derived only.

ASCA Mission T-S RFT (Mission Talon-Strike, loitering-munition flight platform vehicles) appears in search as a 'Current ATM View' title, but the answer snippet indicates the RFT opened 9-May-2025 and closed 30-May-2025 — conflicting signals, so it was EXCLUDED as likely stale/closed rather than risk fabricating an open opportunity. Verify status when egress is restored.

State/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) returned only portal landing pages and non-specific snippets this run; no individual state RFT could be confirmed with a reliable ID via search, so none were captured to avoid fabrication. Tenders WA snippet referenced 'RAAF Pearce Sewage Works' closing 24-Sep-2026 (already past), and ACT/AusTender referenced building-works ATMs closing 24-Sep-2026 (past) — excluded as closed.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery, Sydney Water (SAP Ariba), NBN Co, Coles/Woolworths and mining-major boards are login/registration-gated; no publicly-visible current RFx surfaced via WebSearch. Portals recorded in discovered_sources where new; no corporate opportunities fabricated. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.
AusTender IDs seen in search titles but not examined this run (ATM_2026_3500, ATM_2026_3088, RFI_ATM_2026_6026, RFP49875 ASCA EDT DA, ASCA EDT RFP P2ISR) — deferred to a future run.

Tier 2/3 breadth: only a small rotating sample (BlueScope, Cleanaway, Sydney Water) was probed; hundreds of councils, GBEs, universities and corporate portals were deferred and should rotate on future runs.

tenders.title: ASCA Power Challenge — innovative land-force power generation and management (Land Domain Technology Power Mission)
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence — Advanced Strategic Capabilities Accelerator (ASCA) / Defence Science and Technology Group (DSRG)
tenders.description: ASCA's 'Power Challenge' is a joint Australia–United Kingdom initiative inviting tenders to develop and demonstrate innovative solutions that address emerging land-force energy requirements, framed around Desired Capability Effects (DCEs).
tenders.deliverables_summary: Develop and demonstrate innovative power solutions against one or more Desired Capability Effects, including DCE 1 — Company Level Power Generation and Management: a modular, scalable, low-signature power capability supporting dispersed company-level operations for up to 72 hours independently of higher-echelon power sources. tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of printing and distribution services for Australian Government Bills from 17 September 2026 until 16 September 2029, with possible options to extend by up to a further 2 x 1 year periods.
